name: MLPerf Tiny keyword spotting DS-CNN (int8)
description: MLPerf Tiny 표준 벤치마크의 키워드 인식 참조 모델. 1초 음성의 MFCC(49×10)로 12개 범주(down, go, left, no, off, on, right, stop, up, yes, silence, unknown) 분류. 다른 MCU의 공개 MLPerf Tiny 결과와 비교용.

preprocessing.where: host (PC / server); the board has no microphone
preprocessing.audio: 16 kHz mono int16, up to 1 s (zero padded to 16,000 samples)
preprocessing.steps: float / reduce_max(audio) -> tf.signal.stft(480, 320, Hann) -> |.| -> 40 mel bins 20-4000 Hz -> log(x + 1e-6) -> tf.signal.mfccs_from_log_mel_spectrograms -> first 10 -> [49, 10, 1]
preprocessing.quantization: q = int8(trunc(x / 0.5847029 + 83)), truncation like the reference (clipped to -128..127)
preprocessing.verified: EEMBC kws01 official inputs: 919/1000 byte-identical, 80 differ by +-1 at exact integer boundaries (float noise under truncation, TF version), 1 clip not in our test set; accuracy on the same 999 clips 90.29% (EEMBC inputs) vs 90.39% (ours)

source.reported_accuracy: about 92% on the Speech Commands v2 test set (trained_models/README.md)
source.benchmark: MLPerf Tiny keyword spotting (KWS), EEMBC runner dataset kws01
source.paper: C. Banbury et al. MLPerf Tiny Benchmark. NeurIPS 2021 Datasets and Benchmarks (arXiv:2106.07597): reference DS-CNN 91.6% on the full test set, quality target 90% top-1, 38.6K parameters

dataset.name: Speech Commands v0.02 test set (12-class)
dataset.citation: P. Warden. Speech Commands: A Dataset for Limited-Vocabulary Speech Recognition. arXiv:1804.03209, 2018.
dataset.notes: package eval samples and test_data.npz are MFCC features of these clips (derived data, CC BY 4.0). EEMBC kws01 inputs were only used for verification, not redistributed
